subject: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - Acme Health

Tom — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can kick off the POC next week:

What we covered:
- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference on Acme Health triage assistant workload; primary success criteria: >=92% accuracy on priority intent classification and sub-second median token latency for typical prompts.
- Scope: 2-week technical POC, dataset-driven evaluation using your production prompts + anonymized sample logs.
- Team: you (Tom) as Acme tech lead; Marissa (Sales) and Vivek (SE) from Redwood; Stephanie (CS) will own onboarding/metrics.

Asks / next steps (can you confirm by EOD Wednesday):
1) Share prompt set + representative user logs (anonymized/redacted) — preferably CSV or JSONL. Filename convention is helpful (we gave an example in the call).
2) Provide success criteria details: which intents are high priority (list), metrics thresholds (precision/recall/f1 or top-1 accuracy), and minimum acceptable latency.
3) Point of contact for sending files + any security constraints (SFTP, Drive link, or secure upload).
4) Preferred POC start window — earliest we can begin is Monday Aug 10 if data arrives this week.

Attachments: I’ve included a short template (prompt_sample_template.csv) you can use to drop prompts and expected labels. If easier, drop files to the shared Drive link and cc poc@redwoodinference.com.

We’ll prepare an eval harness and an initial rollout plan once we have the prompts/logs. Vivek will triage any format questions and Stephanie will define the eval metrics and dashboards.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Tom Harris <tharris@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AcmeHealth POC <poc@acmehealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - Acme Health

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the template. Quick answers and files attached.

1) Attached are two files: acme_prompts_v1.csv (sample of 2,500 redacted prompts with expected intent labels) and acme_sample_logs_redacted.zip (10k anonymized sessions, stripped of PHI per our legal). Let me know if this format works.
2) Success criteria: priority intents = ["request_prescription", "schedule_appointment", "symptom_triage"]. Target: overall top-1 accuracy >= 92% on priority intents, per-intent recall >= 90% for prescription and appointment, and F1 >= 0.88 for symptom_triage. Latency target = median generation latency <= 800ms for a 64-token response.
3) Files are on our SFTP. I can grant temporary access — how do we prefer credentials? Alternatively I can share a secure Drive link (we put the link in the body below).
4) We’d like to start Aug 10; can your team confirm availability?

Secure Drive link: https://drive.acmehealth.com/s/secure-example-link

Notes: We redacted patient identifiers but left session-level metadata (intent_label, timestamp, session_id hashed). If you need a particular schema, Vivek please confirm.

—
Tom Harris
Lead Product Manager, Virtual Care | Acme Health
tharris@acmehealth.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - Acme Health

Tom — appreciate the fast turnaround and the files. A few clarifying Qs so our eval harness can be deterministic:

1) Schema: can you confirm the CSV columns in acme_prompts_v1.csv are: prompt_text, expected_intent, priority_flag, source_channel, session_hash? If there are additional columns (metadata) please enumerate.
2) Labeling: are expected_intent values normalized (e.g., exactly \"request_prescription\")? Any synonyms or multi-label cases we should expect?
3) Sampling: the 2,500 prompts — are they stratified by channel or skewed to web chat? If skewed, can we get a balanced sample for evaluation or do you want us to evaluate on the raw distribution?
4) Security: SFTP is fine. Please send credentials to secure-uploads@redwoodinference.com (we’ll rotate keys and confirm receipt). If you prefer Drive, please enable view+download for redwoodinference_poc@redwoodinference.com.

Action items we’ll take once we have the confirmed schema and access:
- Ingest prompts into eval harness and run baseline with a curated model set (we’ll include 2 quantized variants).
- Produce per-intent confusion matrices and precision/recall/F1 for priority intents.
- Capture latency percentiles for typical prompt lengths.
- Deliver an initial report within 5 business days of ingestion.

Marissa / Vivek — we should schedule a 30-min kickoff Aug 10 to review ingestion results and confirm rollouts. I’ll slot options once Tom confirms SFTP vs Drive.

Thanks
—
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, AcmeHealth POC <poc@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC prompt & eval dataset collection - Acme Health

Thanks Tom — got the files and the Drive link. Per Stephanie’s questions, a couple quick confirmations so we can proceed: 

- Tom: please confirm the CSV header exactly (we need column names to map ingestion). If you can paste the header line in reply that’s perfect.
- SFTP: if you prefer SFTP, please send credentials to secure-uploads@redwoodinference.com — we’ll rotate and delete after ingestion.
- Kickoff: Vivek and Stephanie propose Aug 10 at 10:00am PT for a 30-minute kickoff. Does that work for you and the POC team?

Next steps (our side):
- Stephanie will ingest and run baseline within 5 biz days of access.
- Vivek will prepare a short runbook for any format mismatches and will be on the kickoff to triage.
- I’ll coordinate success-criteria signoff once we see initial baseline metrics.

If we get data today, we’re green to start Aug 10. Please confirm header and access method.


Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
